title: A block diagonal pair of cokernel coforks is a cokernel cofork
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an additive category [def-weil-additive-category]. For $k=1,2$, let $a_k:Q_k\to P_k$ and $c_k:P_k\to C_k$ be morphisms such that $c_k$ is a cokernel of $a_k$: $c_ka_k=0$, and every morphism $f:P_k\to T$ with $fa_k=0$ factors uniquely through $c_k$. Define block diagonal maps $a=i_{P_1}a_1p_{Q_1}+i_{P_2}a_2p_{Q_2}:Q_1\oplus Q_2\to P_1\oplus P_2$ and $c=i_{C_1}c_1p_{P_1}+i_{C_2}c_2p_{P_2}:P_1\oplus P_2\to C_1\oplus C_2$, using the biproduct injections and projections. Then $c$ is a cokernel of $a$, with its stated projection map, so the cokernel coforks are compatible with both biproduct injections.

source.place: Tag 01PJ, lemma-directed-colimit-diagram-finite-presentation, proof at the sentence that finite direct sums of finitely presented modules are finitely presented; the generic block-cokernel calculation is an agent-extracted auxiliary lemma for that omitted argument (additive-category notion: Homology Tag 0104, definition-additive-category).

proof.text:
Use ordinary composition, so $uv=u\circ v$. For $V=Q,P,C$, write $i^V_k,p^V_k$ for the two biproduct injections and projections. The relations in [def-weil-additive-category] and bilinearity in [def-weil-preadditive-category] give $ai^Q_k=i^P_ka_k$, $ci^P_k=i^C_kc_k$, and
$$ca=\sum_{k=1}^2 i^C_kc_ka_kp^Q_k=0.$$
The identities $ci^P_k=i^C_kc_k$, together with $ai^Q_k=i^P_ka_k$, are precisely compatibility of the given coforks with both injections.

proof.text: Let $f:P_1\oplus P_2\to T$ satisfy $fa=0$. Put $f_k=fi^P_k$. Step 1 gives $f_ka_k=fai^Q_k=0$. The assumed cokernel property of $c_k$ therefore gives a unique $h_k:C_k\to T$ with $h_kc_k=f_k$. Define $h=h_1p^C_1+h_2p^C_2:C_1\oplus C_2\to T$. The biproduct relations of [def-weil-additive-category], expanded using [def-weil-preadditive-category], give $hi^C_k=h_k$.

source.place: Tags 0103 (remark-direct-sum), 0104 (definition-additive-category), 0106 (definition-kernel, cokernel clause); agent-written binary universal-property calculation for the finite-direct-sum sentence in Tag 01PJ (properties.tex, lemma-directed-colimit-diagram-finite-presentation).

proof.text:
Expanding the maps using bilinearity [def-weil-preadditive-category], the relations $p^C_ki^C_j=\delta_{kj}$ and $\sum_k i^P_kp^P_k=\mathrm{id}$ from [def-weil-additive-category] give
$$hc=\sum_k h_kc_kp^P_k=\sum_k f_kp^P_k=\sum_k fi^P_kp^P_k=f.$$
Thus $h$ is a factor of $f$ through the stated map $c$.

proof.text: If $h':C_1\oplus C_2\to T$ also satisfies $h'c=f$, then $(h'i^C_k)c_k=h'ci^P_k=fi^P_k=f_k$. Uniqueness in the assumed cokernel property of $c_k$ implies $h'i^C_k=h_k$ for both $k$. The identity $\sum_k i^C_kp^C_k=\mathrm{id}$ in [def-weil-additive-category] and bilinearity in [def-weil-preadditive-category] yield $h'=\sum_k(h'i^C_k)p^C_k=\sum_k h_kp^C_k=h$. Together with $ca=0$, this proves the full cokernel universal property for $c$, with the injection identities established in Step 1.
